description:
The authors that every one of two to six named readers has evidence of reading in the Marginalia Corpus, most readers first, with each reader's evidence kept by kind (marks, attested copies or borrows, references in their writing). Narrow to one kind of evidence with evidence.

Example questions:
- "What did Melville and Beckett both read?"
- "Which authors did John Dee and Gabriel Harvey both read?"
- "Authors Gertrude Stein and Hemingway both borrowed"

evidence.description: Which kind of evidence counts. Default any.

name: what_readers_both_read
title: Authors two or more readers both read
